events.title: Sisterly Creations is at the Medora Craft Fair!
events.description: Love unique jewelry with a little Western flair? Come see the Sisters in Medora this Saturday! We’re bringing our jewelry collection to the Medora Craft Fair on Halloween! From the natural beauty of Montana Moss Agates to the striking blue tones of Covellite, we love working with beautiful stones to create special pieces. Handcrafted by Sisterly Creations: Our own Montana Moss Agate and Covellite jewelry, made with care and a love for these beautiful stones. You’ll also find a selection of Turquoise, Jasper, Variscite, rings, earrings, belt buckles, hair pins, and so much more! � Whether you’re looking for a unique Christmas gift or a special treasure for yourself, stop by and see what catches your eye. � Medora Community Center • Medora, ND � Saturday, October 31, 2026 � 9 AM–4 PM Come say hello to the Sisters and discover something beautiful! We can’t wait to see you! �

events.title: Books and Banter: The Cloak
events.description:
Join us in the movie room for a monthly book club featuring Victorian-era literature, including titles found in the Chateau library. The book selections are intended to be easy to read and fun to discuss. Coffee and tea will be provided.

November’s book, “The Cloak” by Nickolai Gogol was originally written in Russian, one of the seven languages Medora von Hoffman spoke! The book tells the story of a quiet clerk whose life changes after he buys a new coat.

"The Cloak" is available to read for free via Project Gutenberg. https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/13437

events.title: ND Cycling Hall of Fame Gala
events.description:
🎄🚴 ND CYCLING HALL OF FAME GALA 🚴🎄 ✨ Honoring the Legends. Celebrating the Journey. Keeping the Wheels Turning. ✨

Join us in Medora during Cowboy Christmas Week for a special evening celebrating the inaugural class of the North Dakota Cycling Hall of Fame!

🏆 HONORING OUR 2026 INDUCTEES Celebrate the athletes, advocates, community builders, industry leaders, and young cyclists who have helped shape the history and future of cycling in North Dakota.

🎉 AN EVENING FULL OF HOLIDAY CHEER!

🎶 Live music 🥔 Hot potato bar ☕ Hot cocoa bar 📸 Festive photo booth 🎁 Door prizes 🔨 Silent auction 🏆 Recognition of our 2026 Hall of Fame inductees 🚲 Special display featuring the North Dakota Cycling Hall of Fame inductees and a historical bicycle collection

📅 Friday, December 4, 2026 🕔 5:00–7:00 PM 📍 Dakota Cycling Adventures 365 Main Street, Medora, North Dakota

Our gala is part of the excitement of Cowboy Christmas Week, making it the perfect opportunity to celebrate cycling, connect with fellow outdoor enthusiasts, and enjoy the holiday spirit in the Badlands!

And the fun doesn't stop there! Join the cycling community the following day for the St. Nick Fat Tire Bike Race hosted by our friends at Save the Maah Daah Hey and enjoy Medora’s Cowboy Christmas…Make a weekend of it!

🎟️ REGISTER TODAY — SEATING IS LIMITED! Don't miss this special opportunity to honor North Dakota's cycling legends and celebrate the future of our sport.

Let's come together to celebrate the people, trails, and communities that keep North Dakota cycling strong!

events.title: Girlfriend Getaway 2027
events.description:
About the Girlfriend Getaway

The Girlfriend Getaway was created from a simple belief: women need spaces where they can reconnect with themselves and with each other.

So many of us spend our days caring for everyone else. Managing it all. Showing up for everyone around us. Somewhere along the way, it gets easy to lose touch with ourselves.

This is now our fourth year gathering, and every time, the same thing happens. Women who don’t know a single soul in the room leave feeling like they’ve found their people.

Three days at the Rough Rider Hotel in Medora, ND. Speakers who share real stories, not polished performances. Small group conversations. Time built in just for you: a massage, a facial, reiki, whatever kind of care your body and heart are asking for. And plenty of open space too, to wander Medora, find a coffee shop, read a book, breathe.

You don’t have to come with a plan. You don’t have to come with friends. You just have to come as you are.

If this is your first time, welcome. You’re exactly where you’re meant to be. If you are returning, we can’t wait to see you again.

Ready to grab your spot? Tickets and all the details are linked above. And be sure to tap Going or Interested so you don’t miss updates as we get closer, we’ll be sharing more in the Discussion tab along the way.
